title: Welcome to SkyRPG
summary: What SkyRPG is, how to install the pack and join the server, and what is inside it.

That is all. The SkyRPG instance brings Fabric Loader, Fabric API and every SkyRPG mod, and keeps them current.
The same SkyRPG version as the server. The instance updates itself, so you always match it.
Install Prism Launcher and sign in with your Minecraft account.
In Prism choose Add Instance, then Import, and pick the zip. An instance called SkyRPG appears.
Launch it. The first start downloads the mods, so it takes a moment. A small window shows the progress.

blocks.text: Good to know before you start

s.x: Your settings and HUD layout are saved on your own computer, not on the server.
Your purse, Bank, skills, pets and collections are saved with your profile on the server.
Item looks come from the FurfSky Reborn resource pack, which the pack installs and keeps on. See
